sections.title: Passage 1: The Connection Between Culture and Thought
sections.html:
surpass

(verb). vượt qua

Ex: He hopes one day to surpass the world record.

response

(noun). câu trả lời, phản hồi

Ex: We have asked for a meeting and we are awaiting a response.

regional

(adjective). thuộc vùng miền

Ex: This issue affects regional security and has international implications.

quantitative

(adjective). thuộc về số lượng

Ex: Our employees receive a quantitative rating based on the dollar value of their sales.

prospective

(adjective). có triển vọng

Ex: I had a phone call from a prospective client today.

prior

(adjective). trước đó

Ex: Although not essential, some prior knowledge of statistics is desirable.

present

(verb). đưa ra, bày ra

Ex: Are you presenting a paper at the conference?

premise

(noun). tiền đề

Ex: His reasoning is based on the premise that all people are equally capable of good and evil.

preconceived

(adjective). nhận thức trước, định trước

Ex: Before I started the job, I had no preconceived notions of what it would be like.

potentially

(adverb). có triển vọng

Ex: This crisis is potentially the most serious in the organization's history.

politics

(noun). chính trị

Ex: She is aiming for a career in politics.

partly

(adverb). một phần

Ex: He was only partly responsible for the accident.

oriental

(adjective). phương đông

Ex: The concrete floor was covered with oriental rugs.

oppose

(verb). đối lập

Ex: Do you support or oppose this proposal?

occidental

(adjective). thuộc phương tây

Ex: The music is a mix of occidental pop and Latin sensuality.

objective

(adjective). khách quan

Ex: I can't really be objective when I'm judging my daughter's work.

modify

(verb). Điều chỉnh

Ex: Patients are taught how to modify their diet.

insight

(noun). cái nhìn sâu sắc

Ex: There are many valuable insights in her book.

globalise

(verb). toàn cầu hóa

Ex: As the economy develops, it will continue to globalize.

generalisation

(noun). sự tổng quát hóa

Ex: Generalization can be dangerous.

former

(adjective). tiền nhiệm, đi trước

Ex: The former option would be much more sensible.

favor

(verb). ủng hộ, thích dùng hơn

Ex: These are the running shoes favored by marathon runners.

factor

(noun). Nhân tố

Ex: The result will depend on a number of different factors.

exist

(verb). Tồn tại

Ex: I don't think ghosts exist.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

ethnicity

(noun). sắc tộc

Ex: Ethnicity is not considered when reviewing applications.

discussion

(noun). sự bàn luận

Ex: I discovered something interesting during a family discussion.

criticise

(verb). chỉ trích

Ex: The decision was harshly criticized by environmental groups.

convincing

(adjective). thuyết phục

Ex: She sounded very convincing to me

connection

(noun). liên kết

Ex: Scientists have established a connection between cholesterol levels and heart disease.

complicated

(adjective). Phức tạp

Ex: It's all very complicated—but I'll try and explain.

awareness

(noun). Nhận thức

Ex: Politicians now have much greater awareness of these problems.

aspect

(noun). Khía cạnh

Ex: The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.

aim

(verb). nhắm vào, hướng vào

Ex: The government is aiming at a 50% reduction in unemployment.

admission

(noun). sự nhận vào

Ex: How many students will gain admission to Yale?

abstract

(adjective). Trừu tượng

Ex: The research shows that pre-school children are capable of thinking in abstract terms.

reaction

(noun). phản ứng

Ex: There has been a mixed reaction to her appointment as director.

point of view

(noun). quan điểm

Ex: There are a number of different points of view on this issue.

certain

(adjective). nào đó

Ex: Certain people might disagree with this.

support

(noun). sự ủng hộ

Ex: There is strong public support for the policy.

explore

(verb). khám phá

Ex: We will explore these ideas in more detail in chapter 7.

description

(noun). Sự miêu tả, sự mô tả

Ex: The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.

valuable

(adjective). quý giá

Ex: You should gain some valuable insights into the world of business.

qualitative

(adjective). thiên về chất lượng

Ex: There are qualitative differences between the two products.

experiment

(noun). thử nghiệm

Ex: Some people believe that experiments on animals should be banned.

affect

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: Your opinion will not affect my decision.

individual

(noun). cá nhân

Ex: The competition is open to both teams and individuals.

scene

(noun). cảnh

Ex: They shot the opening scene 15 times.

focus

(verb). tập trung

Ex: She was distracted and finding it hard to focus.

overall

(adjective). toàn thể, chung

Ex: The overall quality of the articles is good.

widely

(adverb). xa, rộng rãi

Ex: The company is widely acknowledged as a leader in the field.

location

(noun). vị trí, địa điểm

Ex: Mobile phones can determine our exact location and relay it to the police in an emergency.

background

(noun). nền tảng

Ex: The job would suit someone with a business background.

geographical

(adjective). Về mặt địa lý

Ex: The survey covers a wide geographical area.

stick to

(verb). kiên trì, bám vào

Ex: Let's stick to the original plan.

willing

(adjective). sẵn lòng

Ex: Many consumers are willing to pay more for organic food

flexible

(adjective). linh hoạt

Ex: Our plans need to be flexible enough to cater for the needs of everyone.

context

(noun). Bối cảnh

Ex: Such databases are being used in a wide range of contexts.

changeable

(adjective). dễ thay đổi

Ex: The weather is very changeable at this time of year.

base on

(verb). dựa vào

Ex: What are you basing this theory on?

argument

(noun). lý lẽ, lý luận

Ex: Having heard both sides of the argument, the court will make a decision.

position

(noun). vị thế

Ex: She has made her position very clear.

original

(adjective). Nguyên bản, khởi nguồn

Ex: The room still has many of its original features.

unique

(adjective). đặc biệt, độc nhất

Ex: Everyone's fingerprints are unique.

tend

(verb). có xu hướng

Ex: People tend to be happier if they are in a long-term relationship.

strategy

(noun). Chiến thuật

Ex: Follow this strategy for avoiding minor mistakes.

reveal

(verb). Tiết lộ

Ex: The survey reveals some worrying statistics.

mainly

(adverb). chủ yếu

Ex: People come to libraries mainly to borrow books.

aquatic

(adjective). thuộc về nước

Ex: Waterskiing is my favorite aquatic sport.

animate

(verb). tạo hiệu ứng, làm sống động

Ex: Most people know Disney's Snow White as the first animated feature film.

question

(verb). nghi ngờ

Ex: It never occurs to them to question the doctor's decisions.

hibernate

(verb). ngủ đông

Ex: The turtle hibernates in a shallow burrow for six months of the year.

furry

(adjective). có lông

Ex: small furry animals

deduction

(noun). sự suy diễn, sự suy luận

Ex: If my deductions are correct, I can tell you who the killer was.

identify

(verb). Xác định, nhận dạng

Ex: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.

nationality

(noun). quốc tịch

Ex: She has British nationality.

influence

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: His film is heavily influenced by other film-makers.

carry out

(verb). tiến hành

Ex: The hospital is carrying out tests to find out what's wrong with her.

thus

(adverb). do đó, theo cách đó

Ex: The universities have expanded, thus allowing many more people the chance of higher education.

statement

(noun). sự phát biểu, phát ngôn

Ex: He made a rather misleading statement.

assume

(verb). Phỏng đoán

Ex: Let us assume for a moment that the plan succeeds.

conduct

(verb). tiến hành

Ex: Police conducted a thorough search of the building.

variable

(noun). Biến số

Ex: With so many variables, it is difficult to calculate the cost.

research

(noun). nghiên cứu

Ex: His researches in the field of disease prevention produced unexpected results.

effect

(noun). tác động, ảnh hưởng

Ex: What are the long-term effects of this treatment?

critical

(adjective). cấp thiết

Ex: Industry leaders are working together to address this critical issue.

cognitive

(adjective). Liên quan đến nhận thức

Ex: They are studying the links between cognitive and linguistic development in young children.

sections.title: Passage 2: Eco-Resort Management Practices
sections.html:
abandon

(verb). rời bỏ

Ex: Much of the land has now been abandoned in favour of more fertile areas to the south.

aboriginal

(adjective). thuộc về thổ dân

Ex: The Arunta are an aboriginal tribe from central Australia.

achieve

(verb). Đạt được, giành được

Ex: He had finally achieved success.

alternative

(adjective). khác

Ex: The road was closed so we had to find an alternative route.

amenity

(noun). tiện nghi

Ex: The 200-year-old jail is overcrowded, understaffed, and lacking in basic amenities.

approximately

(adverb). xấp xỉ

Ex: The journey took approximately seven hours.

component

(noun). Thành phần

Ex: Nitrogen is the main component of air.

concentrate

(verb). Tập trung

Ex: We're concentrating even harder on giving quality service this year.

conservation

(noun). Sự bảo tồn

Ex: Road development in the area has been severely affected by the conservation programmes of the council.

constraint

(noun). sự hạn chế

Ex: This decision will impose serious constraints on all schools.

contribution

(noun). sự đóng góp

Ex: a significant contribution to scientific knowledge Ex: He made a very positive contribution to the success of the project.

demand

(noun). nhu cầu

Ex: We are seeing an increased demand for housing in the area.

drain

(verb). rút cạn

Ex: We had to drain the oil out of the engine.

dweller

(noun). Cư dân

Ex: Apartment dwellers are still primarily couples and singles.

focus

(noun). Trọng tâm

Ex: Education is the current focus of public debate.

fragile

(adjective). Mong manh dễ vỡ

Ex: The economy remains extremely fragile.

grazier

(noun). người chăn nuôi động vật ăn cỏ

Ex: It may be worth receiving a lower rent and having a more reliable grazier who will keep the land in a tidy condition.

influenza

(noun). cúm

Ex: Frequently referred to as the flu, influenza is a respiratory illness which is caused by a virus.’

interpretive

(adjective). làm sáng tỏ

Ex: an interpretative exhibition Ex: Perhaps my interpretive skills are flagging, but can someone point out the reference to torture here?

occupy

(verb). Chiếm vị trí

Ex: The bed seemed to occupy most of the room.

octagonal

(adjective). bát giác

Ex: There were pictures on every other wall of the octagonal shaped room.

original

(adjective). Nguyên bản, khởi nguồn

Ex: The room still has many of its original features.

rapidly

(adverb). 1 cách nhanh chóng

Ex: Crime figures are rising rapidly.

rare

(adjective). Hiếm hoi

Ex: It is rare to find such loyalty these days.

reception

(noun). quầy tiếp tân

Ex: Please report to reception on arrival.

regard

(verb). Đánh giá

Ex: They regarded people outside their own town with suspicion.

regrettably

(adverb). một cách đáng tiếc

Ex: Regrettably, crime has been increasing in this area.

remnant

(noun). tàn dư, tàn tích

Ex: The woods are remnants of a huge forest which once covered the whole area.

residential

(adjective). thích hợp để ở

Ex: It was not safe to locate the chemicals factory in a residential area.

separate

(verb). chia tách

Ex: South America and Africa separated 200 million years ago.

serene

(adjective). thanh bình

Ex: She seemed, to him, to be at peace, tranquil and serene.

smallpox

(noun). bệnh đậu mùa

Ex: Polio will be the second disease after smallpox to be eradicated.

suitable

(adjective). Phù hợp

Ex: This programme is not suitable for children.

tile

(verb). lợp, lát (gạch, ngói)

Ex: We're going to tile the bathroom.

tribe

(noun). bộ lạc

Ex: The Arunta are an aboriginal tribe from central Australia.

tuberculosis

(noun). bệnh lao

Ex: The hospital has three wards normally devoted to diseases such as tuberculosis.

unique

(adjective). đặc biệt, độc nhất

Ex: Everyone's fingerprints are unique.

urbanised

(adjective). đô thị hóa

Ex: The UK is a highly urbanised country.

contain

(verb). Chứa đựng

Ex: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.

destruction

(noun). tình trạng bị tàn phá, tình trạng bị tiêu diệt

Ex: Children will quickly test their toys to destruction.

dynamite

(noun). thuốc nổ

Ex: They used five tons of dynamite to blow up the rock.

erosion

(noun). Sự xói mòn

Ex: the erosion of the coastline by the sea

eruption

(noun). phun trào

Ex: Geologists understand many of the factors that cause volcanic eruptions.

explosion

(noun). sự nổ

Ex: There were two loud explosions and then the building burst into flames.

intend

(verb). Dự định

Ex: The train we had intended to catch had already left.

subsequent

(adjective). Theo sau

Ex: Developments on this issue will be dealt with in a subsequent report.

volcanic

(adjective). thuộc về núi lửa

Ex: Geologists understand many of the factors that cause volcanic eruptions.

weaken

(verb). làm yếu đi

Ex: This new story has severely weakened the President’s position.

wreck

(verb). bị đắm

Ex: The ship was wrecked off the coast of France.

eventually

(adverb). Cuối cùng

Ex: It might take him ages but he'll do it eventually.

carry out

(verb). tiến hành

Ex: The hospital is carrying out tests to find out what's wrong with her.

consumption

(noun). sự tiêu thụ

Ex: Gas and oil consumption always increases in cold weather.

contamination

(noun). sự làm ô nhiễm

Ex: Environmental contamination resulting from human activities is a major health concern.

install

(verb). Lắp đặt

Ex: Make sure the equipment is properly installed.

minimise

(verb). giảm thiểu

Ex: Good hygiene helps to minimise the risk of infection.

onerous

(adjective). nặng nề, khó nhọc

Ex: She found the duties of motherhood onerous.

preserve

(verb). Bảo quản, giữ gìn

Ex: Efforts to preserve the peace have failed.

threaten

(verb). đe dọa

Ex: Pollution is threatening marine life.

bore

(noun). lỗ khoan (dò mạch mỏ)

Ex: a bore of 16 millimitres.

obtain

(verb). Đạt được, lấy được

Ex: I've been trying to obtain permission to publish this material.

supply

(noun). nguồn cung cấp

Ex: Advances in agriculture increased the food supply.

via

(preposition). thông qua

Ex: The news programme came to us via satellite.

mainland

(noun). lục địa, đất liền

Ex: The Hebrides are to the west of the Scottish mainland.

aquifer

(noun). Tầng chứa nước

Ex: The earth could not absorb the rainwater; as a result groundwater aquifers could not recharge.

desalinize

(verb). khử mặn, khử muối

Ex: The facility desalinizes seawater to produce fresh water for drinking.

extract

(verb). chiết xuất

Ex: a machine that extracts excess moisture from the air

major

(adjective). chủ yếu, quan trọng

Ex: He played a major role in setting up the system.

recharge

(verb). làm đầy lại

Ex: By retaining the water in the drain, the aquifers have been recharged.

unconfined

(adjective). không bị giới hạn

Ex: The animals have unconfined access to pasture.

apply

(verb). ứng dụng

Ex: The policy will apply equally to everyone.

excess

(adjective). dư thừa

Ex: Excess food is stored as fat.

generator

(noun). Máy phát

Ex: Tourism is Australia's greatest generator of employment.

recover

(verb). thu lại, tìm lại được

Ex: The police eventually recovered the stolen paintings.

solar

(adjective). thuộc về mặt trời

Ex: They are searching for intelligent life forms in other solar systems.

administration

(noun). việc quản lí

Ex: Administration costs are passed on to the customer.

enhance

(verb). tăng cường

Ex: This is an opportunity to enhance the reputation of the company.

ensure

(verb). Đảm bảo

Ex: Ex: We are working to ensure the safety of people in the city.

enterprise

(noun). Doanh nghiệp

Ex: He is in charge of an enterprise with a turnover of $26 billion.

implementation

(noun). sự thi hành, sự thực hiện

Ex: Various projects for constructing new schools are under implementation in the region.

principle

(noun). Nguyên tắc

Ex: She went on to explain the principles behind what she was doing.

prospective

(adjective). có triển vọng

Ex: I had a phone call from a prospective client today.

sustainable

(adjective). Có thể duy trì lâu dài; Thân thiện với môi trường

Ex: This type of farming is simply not sustainable any more.

accommodation

(noun). chỗ ở

Ex: Hotel accommodation is included in the price of your holiday.

contemporary

(adjective). đương thời

Ex: He is among the best-known contemporary artists.

embrace

(verb). nắm bắt lấy

Ex: This was an opportunity that he would embrace.

accessible

(adjective). Có thể tiếp cận, truy cập được

Ex: Ex: The beach should be accessible to everyone.

attain

(verb). đạt được

Ex: Most of our students attained five ‘A’ grades in their exams.

ferry

(noun). phà

Ex: We took the ferry to Calais.

locate

(verb). đặt vào vị trí

Ex: They located their headquarters in Swindon.

marina

(noun). bến du thuyền

Ex: Our sailboat is docked at the marina.

offshore

(adjective). ngoài khơi

Ex: The wind was blowing offshore.

trail

(noun). đường mòn

Ex: The hurricane left a trail of destruction behind it.

transport

(noun). sự vận tải

Ex: We need a reliable transport network.

barely

(adverb). hầu như không

Ex: She barely acknowledged his presence.

ceiling

(noun). Trần nhà

Ex: The walls and ceiling were painted white.

old fashioned

(adjective). lỗi thời

Ex: His clothes were curiously old-fashioned.

overhead

(adverb). ở trên đầu

Ex: Planes flew overhead constantly.

air conditioner

(noun). máy điều hòa không khí

Ex: Haven says high winds ruined her curtains and broke her air conditioner.

fridge

(noun). tủ lạnh

Ex: There's no food in the fridge!

forget

(verb). quên

Ex: I forgot to ask him for his address.

mosquito

(noun). con muỗi

Ex: Some types of mosquito transmit malaria to humans.

repellent

(noun). thuốc đuổi sâu bọ

Ex: mosquito repellent Ex: The fruits make good outdoor Christmas ornaments or could be used as insect pest repellents in the winter.

capacity

(noun). sức chứa

Ex: The theatre has a seating capacity of 2 000.

conform

(verb). tuân theo

Ex: It did not conform to the usual stereotype of an industrial city.

eco-friendly

(adjective). thân thiện với môi trường

Ex: Alternative, eco-friendly recipes for cleaning and beauty products are also offered.

expansion

(noun). Sự mở rộng

Ex: "Ex: a period of rapid economic expansion Ex: Expansion into new areas of research is possible"

facility

(noun). cơ sở vật chất

Ex: The school is upgrading its outdoor play facilities.

implement

(verb). thi hành, thực hiện

Ex: A new work programme for young people will be implemented.

integrate

(verb). Tích hợp

Ex: The department has successfully integrated new ideas into the traditional course structure.

principal

(adjective). chính, chủ yếu

Ex: Ex: My principal concern is to get the job done fast.

restrict

(verb). hạn chế

Ex: We restrict the number of students per class to ten.

sections.title: Passage 3: The future of the World's Language
sections.html:
wonder

(noun). điều kì lạ, điều ngạc nhiên

Ex: No wonder you're tired—you've been walking for hours.

wholly

(adverb). hoàn toàn

Ex: The government is not wholly to blame for the recession.

undocumented

(adjective). không được lưu trữ

Ex: People should not stop eating fish because of some undocumented risk of cancer.

undertaking

(noun). nhiệm vụ, công việc

Ex: The construction of the tunnel is a large and complex undertaking.

tutor

(noun). người hướng dẫn; gia sư

Ex: His tutor encouraged him to read widely in philosophy.

tiny

(adjective). rất nhỏ

Ex: We come from a tiny little town in upstate New York.

the nuts and bolts

(noun). những chi tiết cần thiết

Ex: When it came to the nuts and bolts of running a business, he was clearly unable to cope.

set about

(verb). bắt đầu làm

Ex: I tried to apologize, but I think I set about it the wrong way.

represent

(verb). đại diện, biểu trưng

Ex: The artist uses doves to represent peace.

remarkable

(adjective). đáng chú ý, đặc biệt

Ex: He adapted to the new situation with remarkable speed.

regeneration

(noun). sự tái tạo

Ex: The council is committed to a programme of urban regeneration.

refusal

(noun). sự từ chối

Ex: His refusal to discuss the matter is very annoying.

publication

(noun). ấn phẩm

Ex: The study is published this week as an advance online publication.

perpetrator

(noun). thủ phạm

Ex: We will do everything in our power to bring the perpetrators to justice.

origin

(noun). Nguồn gốc

Ex: This particular custom has its origins in Wales.

nefarious

(adjective). xấu xa

Ex: The company's CEO seems to have been involved in some nefarious activities.

myth

(noun). truyền thuyết

Ex: The story parallels the creation myth of the ancient Babylonians.

massive

(adjective). to lớn

Ex: The government put massive amounts of money into the health service.

inevitable

(adjective). Không thể tránh khỏi

Ex: They came to see defeat as inevitable.

incomplete

(adjective). chưa đầy đủ, chưa hoàn thành

Ex: Spoken language contains many incomplete sentences.

homogenous

(adjective). đồng nhất

Ex: The population of the village has remained remarkably homogeneous.

heritage

(noun). di sản

Ex: The building is part of our national heritage.

folklore

(noun). văn học dân gian, truyền thống dân gian

Ex: The story rapidly became part of family folklore.

fate

(noun). số phận

Ex: Fate works in mysterious ways.

ethnic

(adjective). tính dân tộc

Ex: There are continuing ethnic tensions in the region.

entirely

(adverb). hoàn toàn

Ex: The experience was entirely new to me.

enthusiasm

(noun). sự hào hứng, sự hăng hái

Ex: The news was greeted with a lack of enthusiasm by those at the meeting.

engage

(verb). tham gia vào

Ex: The army was regularly engaged in combat.

discuss

(verb). thảo luận

Ex: Have you discussed the problem with anyone?

demand

(noun). nhu cầu

Ex: We are seeing an increased demand for housing in the area.

collate

(verb). Đối chiếu

Ex: to collate data/information Ex: They have begun to collate their own statistics on racial abuse.

certainly

(adverb). chắc chắn, nhất định

Ex: Certainly, the early years are crucial to a child's development.

baffle

(verb). làm bối rối

Ex: I'm baffled as to why she hasn't called.

available

(adjective). có sẵn

Ex: We'll send you a copy as soon as it becomes available.

archive

(noun). Kho lưu trữ

Ex: I've been studying village records in the local archive.

access

(verb). truy cập

Ex: Most people use their phones to access the internet.

population

(noun). Dân số

Ex:The country has a total population of 65 million.

percent

(adverb). phần trăm

Ex: You got 20 percent of the answers right - that means one in every five.

minority

(noun). phần thiểu số

Ex: For a minority, the decision was a disappointment.

set up

(verb). thiết lập

Ex:The slump on Wall Street set up a chain reaction in stock markets around the world.

prevent

(verb). ngăn chặn

Ex: The government took steps to prevent a scandal.

launch

(verb). khởi đầu, bắt đầu

Ex: Police have launched an investigation into the incident.

extinction

(noun). Sự tuyệt chủng

Ex:The island's way of life is doomed to extinction.

disappearance

(noun). sự biến mất

Ex:Many viewers are furious about the programme's sudden disappearance from the schedules.

brink

(noun). bờ vực

Ex: Scientists are on the brink of making a major new discovery.

secure

(verb). chắc chắn, đảm bảo

Ex: The team managed to secure a place in the finals.

grant

(noun). trợ cấp

Ex: There is a lot of competition for research grants.

encourage

(verb). khuyến khích

Ex: My parents have always encouraged me in my choice of career.

enable

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This new programme will enable older people to study at college.

collaborate

(verb). Phối hợp

Ex: Researchers around the world are collaborating to develop a new vaccine.

oral

(adjective). bằng lời nói

Ex: We particularly concentrate on oral fluency.

indigenous

(adjective). bản địa

Ex: The kangaroo is indigenous to Australia.

anthropologist

(noun). nhà nhân chủng học

Ex: There were six investigators; four of them were trained anthropologists, the other two were trained for this purpose.

endangered

(adjective). Có nguy cơ tuyệt chủng

Ex: The sea turtle is an endangered species .

significance

(noun). sự quan trọng, sự đáng kể

Ex: The new drug has great significance for the treatment of the disease.

cultural

(adjective). thuộc về văn hóa

Ex: Teachers need to be aware of cultural differences.

community

(noun). cộng đồng

Ex: The local community supported us from the start.

record

(verb). ghi chép, ghi nhận

Ex: Unemployment is likely to reach the highest total that has ever been recorded.

exist

(verb). Tồn tại

Ex: I don't think ghosts exist.

select

(verb). chọn lọc

Ex: He hasn't been selected for the team.

random

(adjective). Ngẫu nghiên

Ex: He grabbed a random pair of jeans and an old red shirt.

linguist

(noun). nhà ngôn ngữ học

Ex: She's an excellent linguist.

argue

(verb). tranh luận

Ex: Critics argue that Britain is not investing enough in broadband.

similarity

(noun). sự giống nhau

Ex: There is some similarity in the way they sing.

conclude

(verb). Kết luận

Ex: It is too early for us to conclude anything.

simply

(adverb). chỉ là, chỉ

Ex: This is not to suggest we simply ignore the problem.

realise

(verb). nhận ra

Ex: They didn't realise the danger they were in.

inappropriate

(adjective). không phù hợp

Ex: What's the best way for a teacher to deal with inappropriate behaviour?

resource

(noun). Nguồn tài nguyên

Ex: They promote the use of renewable resources like soybean oil.

lack

(verb). thiếu

Ex: The team lacked the skill to compete at the highest level.

devote

(verb). cống hiến

Ex: He devoted his life to serving his family, friends, and neighbors.

outlook

(noun). cách nhìn, quan điểm

Ex: Most Western societies are liberal in outlook.

limited

(adjective). bị giới hạn

Ex: We have limited choices

hold

(verb). tin rằng, cho là

Ex: I still hold that the government's economic policies are mistaken.

focus

(verb). tập trung

Ex: She was distracted and finding it hard to focus.

diverse

(adjective). Đa dạng

Ex: People from diverse cultures were invited to the event.

compare

(verb). so sánh

Ex: We compared the two reports carefully.

aspect

(noun). Khía cạnh

Ex: The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.

apostrophe

(noun). dấu nháy đơn

Ex: "It's" with an apostrophe means "it is" or "it has".

method

(noun). Phương pháp

Ex: Which method is the most effective?

revival

(noun). sự hồi sinh

Ex: He claimed the market was showing signs of a revival.

resurrect

(verb). làm sống lại

Ex: He has succeeded in resurrecting his career in television.

proof

(noun). bằng chứng

Ex: These results are a further proof of his outstanding ability.

distrust

(verb). không tin, ngờ vực

Ex: She distrusted his motives for wanting to see her again.

cite

(verb). biểu dương, trích dẫn

Ex: He cited personal reasons for his decision to resign.

restoration

(noun). Việc phục dựng

Ex: The palace is closed for restoration.

initiative

(noun). Kiến nghị, sáng kiến

Ex: Most policy initiatives come from the White House.

embrace

(verb). nắm bắt lấy

Ex: This was an opportunity that he would embrace.

struggle

(noun). sự vật lộn, sự đấu tranh

Ex: They face an uphill struggle to get to the finals of the competition.

prospect

(noun). Triển vọng, khả năng

Ex: There's a reasonable prospect that his debts will be paid.

pipe dream

(noun). mơ mộng viễn vông

Ex: Her plans are not realistic - they'll never be more than a pipe dream.

mere

(adjective). ít, nhỏ không đáng kể

Ex: It took her a mere 20 minutes to win.

alive

(adjective). còn tồn tại

Ex: Money from charities is keeping the theatre alive.

achieve

(verb). Đạt được, giành được

Ex: He had finally achieved success.

rapid

(adjective). Nhanh chóng

Ex: The patient made a rapid recovery.

paradox

(noun). nghịch lý

Ex: It is a curious paradox that professional comedians often have unhappy personal lives.

globalisation

(noun). sự toàn cầu hóa

Ex: We must take advantage of the increased globalisation of the commodity trading business.

foremost

(adverb). quan trọng nhất, trước hết

Ex: He does a little teaching, but first and foremost he's a writer.

facility

(noun). cơ sở vật chất

Ex: The school is upgrading its outdoor play facilities.

erode

(verb). bào mòn đi

Ex: The experience had seriously eroded his confidence in himself.

critical

(adjective). mang tính nhận xét, đánh giá

Ex: His latest film attracted enthusiastic critical comment from cinema-goers.

identity

(noun). cá tính, đặc tính

Ex: Scotland has never lost its identity as a separate nation.

remind

(verb). nhắc cho nhớ

Ex: Could you remind Paul about dinner on Saturday?

realistic

(adjective). thực tế

Ex: We have to be realistic about our chances of winning.
